insights.text: 4 of the world's 50 tallest buildings were completed in 2025 alone.
Shenzhen and New York City tie for the most towers in the top 50: 6 each.
15 of the top 50 were completed in 2020 or later.
Only 8 of the top 50 stand in the Americas, all of them in the United States.
Only 4 completed buildings on Earth rise higher than 600 m.

scope_note: What counts: buildings listed as completed by the Council on Vertical Urbanism (CVU, formerly CTBUH) Skyscraper Center on 3 Nov 2026, measured to the architectural top (spires count, antennas don't). Chongqing's International Land-Sea Center (458 m) and Shandong IFC (428 m) are topped out but not yet listed as completed by CVU, so they are not included. Hong Kong is counted under China.
